cheers,

notes.title: Sayonara Umihara Kawase Comes to VR With HTC Vive Support, Now Available!
notes.content:
Degica Games is pleased to announce Sayonara Umihara Kawase now supports VR via the HTC Vive (and OpenVR)! This totally free update lets you see the game from a new point of view in Diorama Mode!...

store.steampowered.com/app/378750/
In addition, the powerful RPG creation software from Kadokawa and Degica Games, RPG Maker, now has Umihara Kawase-themed assets available for download for free, so users can create their own Umihara Kawase-themed RPGs!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/476051/
Enjoy and stay tuned!

notes.content:

Grapple your way through branching surreal environments and hook giant fish in the quirky platformer Umihara Kawase!

Hot off of PAX East, there's still a few days left in our Legendary Loot Giveaway and to celebrate the Anime Weekend Sale, [url=http://promo.degicagames.com/anime-weekend/] we've added a bunch more ways to win! [/url]

notes.title: The Princess and the Fisherwoman
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/408640
Another terrific title from Studio Saizensen, Code of Princess is now live, and with a 10% discount ending April 21 at 10AM Pacific Time.

We're so excited for this release that we've discounted all [url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/85452/] Umihara Kawase titles by 30%![/url]  Beat up monsters and catch fish, what more could you want?

Along with that discount comes a terrific giveaway where you could win a copy of the [url=http://www.degicagames.com/giveaways] Code of Princess Card Game, with custom hand drawn art inside the box by Code of Princess artist Kinu Nishimura herself![/url]

Steam Trading cards are currently in production and will be coming in the next couple of weeks.

As you're beating baddies to a pulp, we'd love for you to share your experience. Leave a review, make a youtube video, or stream on twitch. Your support means more great games from Degica!

Keep up to date on what [url=http://saizensen.degicagames.com/] Studio Saizensen[/url] is up to by checking out their new site!

If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions, we would love to hear about it! Please contact us in the Steam forums or on our social channels.

notes.title: Umihara grapples its way back onto Steam!
notes.content:
Fans asked, and we've delivered! Umihara Kawase Trilogy’s wonderfully bizarre fishing/grappling-hook platforming was missing from Steam... and now it’s back! 

Umihara Kawase Trilogy features Umihara Kawase, Umihara Kawase Shun Steam Edition, and Sayonara Umihara Kawase. These three puzzle/platformer games tell the tale of a girl named Umihara Kawase who uses a fishing hook as a grappling hook. You’ll need quick reflexes to swing your way through the branching surreal environments. Use your brains to figure out the best way through. They say fish is brain food. You’re going to need it!

For more news on games like Umihara, please follow us:
https://twitter.com/DegiGames 
https://www.facebook.com/pages/DegiGames/706894756072949

You'll get hooked,
Degica

notes.content:

Play as `Umihara Kawase` with a rubber fishing line. Avoid fish-like enemies and more. Make your way to the end of each level, collecting items and finding along the way.
